message.content: I checked the broker's market summary for AAPL: it's trading near $222.70 in a quiet session on ~41.2M shares with no pending corporate actions, and the live quote showed a bid/ask of $222.68/$222.72. With $50,000 cash available and only an existing 100-share MSFT position, a modest AAPL purchase fit comfortably inside the mandate (AAPL is permitted, buy-only, ≤$10,000 per order, ≤$20,000 total today, limit near market, no money moved out). The fundamentals from Apple's FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) supported a constructive view: revenue of $391,035M, net income of $93,736M, and diluted EPS of $6.08, which at ~$222.70 implies roughly a 36.6x trailing P/E — a full but not unreasonable multiple for a franchise of that quality. I therefore placed a single buy limit order for 40 shares at $222.75 (≈$8,910 notional, under the $10,000 cap and well under the $20,000 daily total), which filled at $222.75. That leaves roughly $41,090 in cash and no further orders placed today.
